title: Vaults and banks
description: Where the shop keeps its money: safes in each branch and bank accounts.

emptyHint: Add a safe or a bank account to start.

fields.name: Name
fields.branchHelp: A safe belongs to a branch; a bank account can be shop-wide. This can't change later.

errors.name: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.
errors.openingNote: Write a note of 3 to 500 characters.
errors.nameTaken: Another account in this branch has this name.
errors.hasBalance: The account still holds money. Move it out first.
errors.isDefault: This is a branch's default vault. Choose another default first.
errors.hasMovements: The account already has movements; an opening balance is only for a new account.
errors.insufficientFunds: Not enough money in the source vault.
errors.dayClosed: The day is closed for this branch.
errors.branchDenied: You don't work in this account's branch.
errors.permission: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.expired: The subscription has ended; the shop is read-only.

ledger.title: Account ledger
ledger.notFoundHint: It may belong to a branch you don't work in.
ledger.loadFailed: The ledger could not be loaded.
ledger.caption: Account movements with the running balance

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: The cash each cashier handles during a shift: float, drawer and closing count.
shifts.emptyHint: Shifts appear here once a cashier opens one.

open.title: Open a shift
open.floatHelp: Cash taken from a safe to start with. Leave 0 for none.
open.noVaults: This branch has no active safe.

current.expected: Cash that should be in the drawer
current.expectedHelp: The float plus every cash movement of this shift.
current.noMovements: No cash has moved in this shift yet.

cash.inHelp: Change or extra float from the safe into the drawer.
cash.outHelp: Cash you take out of the drawer and put in the safe.
cash.noteInvalid: Write a note of 3 to 500 characters.

close.title: Close the shift
close.help: Count the cash in the drawer. The counted cash goes back to a safe.
close.reasonRequired: Counted and expected differ: write a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
close.vaultRequired: Choose the safe the counted cash goes to.
